def bulk_discount_total(qty, unit_cents):
    """Picture the checkout counter at a warehouse club where buying in bulk
    earns you a small break on the bill. You're given a quantity of items and
    a price per unit, and your job is to work out what the customer owes, in
    cents. Here qty and unit_cents are ints with qty >= 0 and unit_cents >= 0.
    Small orders just pay the straightforward total, but once the order is big
    enough the discount kicks in. If qty >= 10 return (qty * unit_cents * 9)
    // 10 (a 10% discount with integer floor division); otherwise return
    qty * unit_cents. That's the whole calculation, nothing fancier.

    >>> bulk_discount_total(9, 100)
    900
    >>> bulk_discount_total(21, 213)
    4025
    """
